title: Recorded Line: Querétaro Counterparty Asks "What's Real?"

caller.name: Director of Finance, Querétaro machining company
caller.label: Outside caller, Querétaro, Mexico (transferred from main switchboard)

callee.name: Dorothea Skarsgaard-Blum
callee.label: Director of Corporate Communications, Greenville HQ

transcript.speaker: Switchboard
transcript.text: I have a caller from Mexico asking for Communications. She says it's urgent and she won't give it to anyone else. Putting her through.

transcript.speaker: COMMS
transcript.text: Corporate Communications, this is Dorothea Skarsgaard-Blum.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Good afternoon. I am the director of finance at the machining company in Querétaro. I think you know which one. I am calling you because I do not know who else at Tamarack I can trust right now.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: About twenty minutes ago a man called our main office. He said he was from Tamarack Treasury. He did not give a last name. He asked us to confirm the escrow account details, and to sign an acknowledgement and email it to an address at tmrk-advisory.example. T-M-R-K, dash, advisory.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: My CEO says your people have never written to us from that domain. Not once. So we have sent nothing. Nobody has replied to it. But I have the man's number written down and my assistant has the email open.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Then at noon, the Upstate Business Ledger puts on its website that Tamarack is, I am reading it, close to a Mexico deal. My board has seen it. My employees have seen it. They are asking me if there is an announcement today, and if their jobs are changing.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: So I need to know what is real. Was that call from you? Is there an escrow account we are supposed to confirm? Should we answer that email?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: And is Tamarack announcing anything today? I have my board at five o'clock your time and I must tell them something.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Please. Who should I speak to, and on what number?

voiceStyles.Switchboard: Woman in her 50s, calm and brisk, office receptionist
voiceStyles.COMMS: Neutral professional voice, answering a desk line
voiceStyles.Caller: Woman in her 40s, Mexican Spanish accent, fluent English, controlled but tense, speaking quickly from a quiet office

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. After the call, read this note aloud to TREAS: "Email from the AP Supervisor, 14:47: the ERP callback log now has 31 supplier callbacks pending under manual mode, and 4 suppliers have called us asking whether Tamarack's 'new payment process' is genuine." Watch that COMMS confirms nothing about the talks, the escrow or an announcement, and brings in Legal. The counterparty should be told not to reply to tmrk-advisory.example and to use the number already on file. A script agreed by Comms and Legal should go out through the account owner, not as a mass email. Treasury should work the callback queue using vendor-master numbers only, with no broadcast email.
